detail.longDescription: 🚀 Managing Linux containers and VMs just got smoother! Check out Incus Commander—a modern, streamlined web-based UI designed specifically for spinning up lightweight containers or full virtual machines, it gives you a clean interface to keep your homelab or infrastructure organized and under control. 📺 Take a quick video walkthrough of it in action: https:// youtu.be/IAnnHdmefo8 Explore the source code: 🔗 https:// forge.routemehome.org/brian/in cus-commander # Incus # SelfHosted # Linux # Containers # Homelab # OpenSource
